evidence.title: Bluva — Free Website Template for Framer

name: Bluva
summary: Free dark agency and portfolio website template for Framer with 7 pages, CMS collections and a Figma file.
description: Dark, editorial Framer template for creative studios, digital agencies, branding agencies and freelancers. Includes 7 designed pages, 2 CMS collections (Projects + Articles), a homepage video section and editorial photography layouts, plus an editable Figma design file, a getting-started guide and lifetime updates. Built natively in Framer with drag-and-drop editing, global color and font styles and no coding required.
contains: free dark agency and portfolio template for Framer
video section on the homepage; editorial photography layouts
